planets.name: WASP-132 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-132 with a 7.13-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: WASP-132 b was found in 2016 by SuperWASP-South as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around WASP-132. Its orbit and size follow Grieves et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
